Interface ReplicationSettingsPostProcessor

public interface ReplicationSettingsPostProcessor

Known derived/implementing types:
PaymentAuthorizationPostProcessor, StripeTransactionPostProcessor, StripeWebhookIntegrationServiceTest.ExceptionThrowingPostProcessor

Interface for implementing post-processing logic after records are saved through replication settings.

This interface defines a contract for classes that need to perform additional operations after a record has been created or updated via the replication/webhook integration process. Implementations can use this to create related records, update relationships, or perform any custom business logic based on the original payload and the newly saved record.

Implementing classes are specified in the ReplicationSettings__mdt.PostProcessor__c field and are automatically invoked by the replication framework after successful record persistence.

Executes post-processing logic after a record has been saved.

This method is invoked automatically by the replication framework after a record is successfully created or updated. Implementations should contain all business logic that needs to run after the initial record save, such as creating related records, updating relationships, or performing additional data transformations.


Parameters:
    recordId – The ID of the record that was just saved
    payload – The original JSON payload used to create or update the record
